purpose: Teach: イラストレーター/セレモニー/グラビア/コミケ/ゴシック/サイクリング/猪木/サンタクロース

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、イラストレーターになりたいって言ってたな
lines.en: Riku — you said you wanted to be an illustrator.
lines.style: Teasing opening, playful pitch. Soft, knowing smile in the voice. Drawing out the accusation gently, inviting him to remember. Like she's caught him being earnest.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、卒業セレモニーで泣いてたな、桜
lines.en: You cried at the graduation ceremony, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick parry, half-smile. Defensive counter delivered as a joke — but there's a flicker of sincerity underneath. Not mean. Just turning it back on her before she gets too close.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、グラビア雑誌こっそり読んでたな
lines.en: Riku — you were secretly reading gravure magazines.
lines.style: Slightly sharper tease, raised eyebrow in the voice. Delighted at catching him. Quick tempo, no hesitation — she's enjoying this. The tone says she likes him for it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、コミケ行ってきたな、桜
lines.style: Caught-red-handed mirror. Quicker tempo than before, a grin underneath. Not embarrassed — amused that she's trying to get the upper hand back. The rhythm says this is familiar sparring.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ゴシック建築の本買ってたな
lines.en: Riku — you were buying books on Gothic architecture.
lines.style: Slower, more thoughtful delivery. The tone shifts — less teasing, more genuine curiosity disguised as teasing. She's noticing something about him. Quieter at the end, like she's seeing him see something beautiful.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、週末サイクリングしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were cycling on the weekends, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter response, matching her shift in energy. Not defensive this time — almost gentle. He's noticing her noticing him. Slower pace, breath underneath. The tone says: I see you too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、猪木の名言マネしてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were doing Inoki impressions.
lines.style: Quick laugh underneath. Sharp, affectionate tease. She's mimicking him back — loud, theatrical, unguarded. The tempo jumps. She's being more herself now, less guarded.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、サンタクロース信じてた頃のお話してたな、桜
lines.en: You were telling stories about when you used to believe in Santa, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft, close to her. The tone is tender underneath the joke. Slower, deliberate — he's naming something vulnerable she showed him. Not mocking. Protective of the admission. Breath warm and near.
